points.en: Multilateral development bank focused on infrastructure in Asia.

points.en: Established in 2016 to complement existing MDBs like World Bank and ADB.

points.en: India is a founding member and the second-largest shareholder.

fiveFacts.en: Operates under the principle of lean, clean, and green.

threeTraps.en: Assuming AIIB is only for Asian countries (it has non-regional members).

threeTraps.en: Confusing voting power with one-country-one-vote (it is share-based).
